title: Decision: relay-join and leave publish to the change bus
description: Audit item 6. The only change signal is follower/notify.rs:192 (per appended event). Follower::relay_update's add_follower_member (follower/mod.rs:187) and Follower::leave (follower/mod.rs:259) change Chat visibility without signalling, so EventSource clients miss new and unbound Chats. Audit correction: Welcome-driven joins go through append_fanout and already signal. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): both paths publish a membership change to the bus; done in .11.3 (after .7.31 lands), with tests that a StateChange follows each.
